name: Personalized Wooden Wine Bottle Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality wood for a sturdy, durable, and elegant presentation.
    - Crafted from 5mm wooden panels for a solid structure and long-lasting use.
    - Features a natural wood look that adds warmth and a premium handmade feel.
    - Designed with a fitted lid and side panels for a secure and decorative bottle holder.
    - Includes a rope handle with approx. 5mm thickness for easy carrying and hanging.
    - Smooth cut edges and layered construction create a neat and refined finished appearance.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall product size: 14.2 x 4 in ~ 36.06 x 10.16 cm.
    - Width of each side: 4 in ~ 10.16 cm.
    - Designed to hold 1 standard wine bottle securely.
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing  Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Lid panel: 2-sided printing.
    - Front panel: 2-sided printing.
    - Back panel: 2-sided printing.
    - Left panel: 2-sided printing.
    - Right panel: 2-sided printing.
    - Base panel: 2-sided printing.
    - Nut layer 1: No printing.
    - Nut layer 2: 2-sided printing.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed to hold and present one standard wine bottle in a stylish and secure way.
    - Helps turn a regular wine bottle into a more elegant and personalized gift.
    - Suitable for gift presentation, storage, and decorative display.
    - Can be used for weddings, anniversaries, birthdays, housewarming parties, and holiday celebrations.
    - Great for displaying personalized names, initials, monograms, or meaningful messages.
    - The vertical box structure helps keep the bottle neatly enclosed and well supported.
    - Rope handle makes it easier to carry, move, or hang for decorative purposes.
    - Can be reused after gifting as a keepsake box or decorative wine-themed display piece.
    - Ideal for table décor, gift tables, party setups, and home bar displays.
    - Adds a warm, rustic, and premium touch to wine gifting for special occasions.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect gift for wine lovers, couples, family members, friends, and coworkers.
    - Great for weddings, anniversaries, and engagement celebrations.
    - A thoughtful gift choice for housewarmings, birthdays, and holiday events.
    - Ideal for Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, and retirement gifts.
    - Suitable for personalized gifting with monograms, names, or custom messages.
    - A beautiful keepsake that combines practical use and decorative value.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Personalized Wooden Wine Bottle Box

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
